_about: Pinned, reproducible training recipe for the shipped bone-age screening model (Plan 3 WI-1). Any candidate model must record its own recipe so results are comparable and the shipped 8.6mo baseline is reproducible. This describes what produced backend/ai/models/boneage_gp.onnx.
task: whole-image Greulich-Pyle bone-age regression (screening, NOT TW3)
architecture: MobileNetV3-Small backbone + [global-pooled features (576) + sex (1)] -> Linear(256) -> ReLU -> Dropout(0.3) -> Linear(1)
channels: grayscale replicated to 3, ImageNet mean/std normalisation

augmentation.note: no horizontal flip -- hands are always left; flipping would corrupt laterality

caveats: RSNA is a US cohort; GP skeletal age runs biased in Indian children -- handle with a LEARNED per-subgroup recalibration (PLAN-3 WI-6), never a fixed universal offset.
The 15% split is a TUNING/val split, not a locked external test; carve a locked test per PLAN-5 WI-1 before release claims.
